garbo.linePrev: Especially to be here without you
garbo.line: There's a Greta Garbo and an Alfred Hitchcock
stanza: There's a Greta Garbo and an Alfred Hitchcock
There's five Cinderellas and some leather drags
I almost fell into my mug
There's a Crawford, Davis and a tacky Cary Grant
And some Homeboys lookin' for trouble down here from the Bronx
